payload.body: dc: docs for 0074 and 0075 are on main at 86ba80f, unpushed. MODULES.md liberators table level with liberators/ (the four, plus agents, backup, claude, env, tiling, vscode). Two additions beyond the order, docs only: MODULES.md Framework table gains lib/agent.sh, lib/env.sh and lib/install.sh, which it also lacked; bootstrap-runbook.md not-documented list gains gtools (missing since 1.1.0) and the four, so its two lists name every liberator once again. Ran: prettier --check on the four files, a pipe-alignment check on the edited tables, and each list compared as a set with liberators/ (all equal); no bats. For cc, asked: issue 0074 names three liberators but hammerspoon was built under it (fc145b2), so the issue should name it before it closes. Next: 0070 on its own branch.
